c-A1-20261028171745.text: Recorded. I'll remove "no sign-up required" from the spec. I've rewritten C2 to match, since there are no guest orders now, and D5 asks whether customers can request refunds from their account.

c-A2-20261028171745.text: Recorded as Singapore and Malaysia. I'll keep Australia out of the launch spec; if you decide on it later, say so here and I'll add the Australia questions.

c-B1-20261028171745.text: 60 seconds on a spinner is long on mobile; people tend to leave or tap back and pay again. The usual pattern is a short "checking" wait, then an order-pending page and an email once the result is in, with a retry offered only after a definite failure. That also suits PayNow and FPX, where the result can arrive after the customer comes back from their bank app. I've rewritten the recommendation that way: wait up to 30 seconds, then the pending page.

c-B2-20261028171745.text: I read this as: cards everywhere, plus PayNow in Singapore and FPX in Malaysia, and no other local methods (no e-wallets, for example). Is that right, or did you mean no cards at all?

quick.label: Yes: cards, plus PayNow and FPX
No: only PayNow and FPX, no cards

c-B3-20261028171745.text: I don't have the old system's retry rules, so I can't copy them yet. If you know them, reply here; otherwise pick one below. Either way this only covers cards: PayNow and FPX payments are started by the customer, so they can't be retried automatically.

c-_general-20261028171745.text: Added a new group, D Refunds, with 5 questions: whether and how partial refunds work (D1), how the amount is worked out with discounts, shipping and tax (D2), where the money goes, including PayNow and FPX (D3), who can issue refunds (D4), and whether customers can request them from their account (D5). Start with D1.

A1.text: Accounts required: customers sign in or create an account before paying, because most buyers are B2B and reorder.

A2.text: Launch in Singapore and Malaysia. Australia is not in the launch scope and is still undecided.

A3.text: Success criteria: p95 time from Pay to confirmation under 3 seconds, and checkout takes at most 3 screens.
